title: Simplifying tactile images with TactileView
summary: A webinar demonstrates how to use TactileView software with a screen reader to create tactile graphics, showcasing menu-driven design and built-in portals for accessible tactile images.
body:
A webinar demonstrates how to use TactileView software with a screen reader to create tactile graphics, showcasing menu-driven design and built-in portals for accessible tactile images.

title: Ministry of Labor’s Six Calculation Web Pages Pass AA Accessibility Certification
summary: The Ministry of Labor announced that its six major calculation web pages have obtained the AA level of the web accessibility symbol, ensuring zero‑distance access to labor rights information.
body:
The Ministry of Labor announced that its six major calculation web pages have obtained the AA level of the web accessibility symbol, ensuring zero‑distance access to labor rights information.
